Geographies Served Programs Educating Girl Child District Jaipur State Rajasthan District Jaipur States Rajasthan Started with 23 girls from urban slums, the school now has over 600 girl students. It is heartening that Vimukti has been able to make a difference in the lives of these girls, and in the attitude of their parents towards them. Mothers are now active in Parent-Teacher Days and report growing confidence of their girls and positive changes in fathers’ attitudes towards girls’ education. Seven girls from the original 2004 batch are in college on scholarship, two after vocational training are in jobs. School Board examinations pass rate is 100%. Nutrition To Vimukti Girls District Jaipur State Rajasthan District Jaipur States Rajasthan Vimukti Sanstha provides nutritional snacks (fruit/ chana/ protein-rich snacks, etc.) and milk to 650 girls in their schools everyday to support nutrition of girls and encourage parents to send girls to school. It gives us immense pride to see where we have reached today- providing quality education to 650 girls, identifying and nurturing their hidden talents and helping them in becoming successful professionals. Vimukti aims to educate all the underprivileged girls who don not depend on their family members rather they should be their own bread & butter earners. --> Milestones & Track Record 2004 Vimukti Sanstha began its journey with just 20 girls. 2012 Rajasthan Board for secondary Education (RBSE) affiliation. English introduced as a medium of instruction till grade 3. 2013 1st Smart Class introduced. 2017 The Post-School Career Support Programme initiated. 2018 A dedicated Career Development Center established. Arts and Commerce stream introduced at Senior Secondary level. 2019 4 Student won Silver Medals in District-level Judo tournament. 2020 Free tablets given to 410 students for online learning during Covid19 lockdown. 83% students secured distinction grades in X & Xll Rajasthan Board exams. 2021 Science Stream introduced at Senior Secondary level. English as a medium of English introduced till grade XI. AI-powered digital learning & assessment tool Mindspark introduced. 2022 Early Childhood development center established. The school won the Best School (Girls) award in the District-level boxing tournament where the school bagged 4 medals- 2 Gold, 1 Silver and 1 Bronze. Muskan Verma won a Bronze medal at State-level boxing tournament 2022. --> --> Leadership Team Lavalina Sogani Founder Secretary Sumit Sharma CEO Jyoti Dixit Principal Shailendra Agarwal Chairperson Isha Swarup Head-Career Development Program Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength 12 Diversity Metrics 80% women Organization Structure Yes M&E Internal, External Assessors Yes --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Organisation Structure Organisation Structure Yes --> Awards & Recognitions Best NGO in Rajasthan in 2022 --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATV7090D Registration Number 204 Jaipur/2004-05 CSR Form 1 CSR00016685 80G AAATV7090DF20214 12A AAATV7090DE20042 FCRA 125560226 About Headquarters Jaipur, Rajasthan Since 2003 Demographies Served Girls --> Impact Since its inception, Vimukti Sanstha has educated over 1,400 girls, with many graduates pursuing higher education or gaining employment, breaking the cycle of poverty in their families.
